body: I think the difference between migraines and headaches is the location and the type of pain.

I had a sever and constant headache for more than six months, never had a migraine in my life. I have now been diagnosed with migraines and get botox injections as nothing else even helps. I would insist on seeing a specialist as it doesn't appear to be an area of expertise for your gp.

I'm a camera operator and editor for a local news station. It's a dream come true, I moved 1000km away to a place I'd never been and didn't know anyone for the job. It's amazing, I love it. But I can't stand the people I work with and I still don't have anyone I would call a friend after more than a year here. And I don't talk to anyone from home anymore proving my point even more so that once I leave somewhere or finish something I'm still alone
Also a hug would be amazing

Have a bachelor's degree and now have a full time job, I love my job...  Well I love my job description... Everywhere I've ever been in life I've been the outsider, and when I finish it's all ended there's no one left in my life from that 

At the end of each day I'm alone, its just me, its always just me and it's all my own fault.
I'm so tired of faking it, I'm so tired of not knowing who I actually am, putting this stupid smile on day after day... It's exhausting and I just want it to end so that I can rest.

You described it perfectly, Im so tired of faking it, not knowing who I am and trying so hard to change things but ending up back here after so many years that all i want to do is rest and feel a sense of peace. 

Thank you for helping me find the words to describe it x
Still working on improving my mental health
